brand.name: Multi Taille Services
brand.aesthetic: Premium, moderne, professionnel, rassurant, naturel, field manual / Pays d'Auge terroir
brand.core_goal: OBTENIR DES APPELS. Phone calls only (tel:0767234123). No forms, emails, or chat.

hierarchy.overline: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-sans font-semibold text-vivid-orange

rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Always use Serif (Cormorant Garamond) for headings and clear geometric Sans (Manrope) for body.
Numbered manifesto-style chapters for sections (e.g., '01. Élagage', '02. Abattage').
Use Deep Forest Green for backgrounds of dark sections and large typography.
Vivid Orange MUST be reserved ONLY for Call-to-Action buttons and phone numbers to draw the eye purely for conversion.
Backgrounds should be Bone White/Off-White for a natural, organic 'terroir' feel, avoiding stark sterile white (#FFFFFF).
No muddy gradients. Stick to solid colors and sharp contrasts.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle SVG grain or noise overlay on Forest Green sections to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Clipped frames with slight border radius (max 8px) for photography. No excessive rounding.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist. Use sharp drop shadows or optical clarity (glassmorphism with subtle border) for sticky elements.
visual_enhancers.parallax: Subtle parallax on hero images and large image breaks.
visual_enhancers.marquee: One slow editorial marquee (e.g., 'Appel direct, réponse rapide • Devis gratuit • Interventions Lisieux et Pays d\'Auge') using a serif font.

motion.scrolling: MANDATORY: Use `lenis` for smooth momentum scrolling. It gives the site a premium weight.
motion.reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveals on headings using framer-motion (e.g., intersection observer + translateY).
motion.hover: Image zoom on hover within clipped bounds. CTAs scale up slightly with an inner glow or solid shadow offset.

layouts.spacing: Generous asymmetric spacing. Use Tailwind's p-12, p-24, p-32. Let elements breathe.
layouts.grid: Bento Grid Protocol: Mode A (Tetris grid) for galleries. Overlapping elements for the hero section.

pages.home: Large kinetic hero -> Services Grid (editorial cards) -> Zone d'intervention (map/list) -> Réalisations (masonry gallery) -> Avantages (manifesto list) -> FAQ -> Final CTA band.
pages.service: Service Hero -> Intro & Benefits -> Before/After or Process -> Internal links to Local Pages -> CTA -> FAQ.
pages.local: Local Hero -> Tailored content for the specific city -> Services offered here -> Testimonials/Réalisations -> CTA.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded, Vivid Orange background, White text, high contrast. Must say 'Appeler maintenant' with phone icon (tel:0767234123).
buttons.floating_mobile: Fixed bottom-right or full width bottom bar on mobile. Extremely visible and persistent.

header.style: Sticky header. Solid Bone White background or Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md + border-b). Never fully transparent.
header.content: Logo (left), minimal nav (center), Vivid Orange CTA button with phone number (right).

cards.style: Flat design, 1px subtle stone border, Bone White or Forest Green background. Hover: slight lift and border darken.

faq.style: Shadcn accordion customized with large serif typography for questions, thin border-bottom separators, + / - toggle icon.

breadcrumbs.style: Small, muted text (stone-500) at the top of service/local pages for heavy SEO internal linking.

instructions_to_main_agent: NO FORMS. NO EMAILS. NO CHAT. The only conversion mechanism is the phone number (tel:0767234123).
Focus heavily on Mobile First design. The floating mobile call button is critical.
Ensure SEO structure is semantic: exactly one H1 per page, logical H2/H3s.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide-React for crisp, premium icons.
Implement Framer Motion for scroll-reveals but keep it highly performant.
Use standard semantic HTML sections, styled via Tailwind. Extract standard components into the `components/ui` folder. Ensure usage of .js (JSX) extensions rather than .tsx.
Maintain the strict Color Palette (Forest Green + Bone White + Vivid Orange). Do not invent new colors.
Implement the 'editorial marquee' feature natively or with `react-fast-marquee`.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Vivid Orange against White/Bone meets 3:1 for large text or buttons. Ensure White against Forest Green meets 4.5:1.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for the phone buttons indicating 'Call Multi Taille Services now'.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus state (ring-vivid-orange).

testing.data_testid_conventions: All interactive/important elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case. Examples: 'call-cta-header', 'service-card-elagage', 'faq-accordion-item', 'floating-call-button'.

image_urls.description: Arborist expertly climbing a tall bare tree
Stone wall with plants and narrow window

media.usage_rules: Images must look like real job sites (réalisations) with a premium photography treatment. Avoid generic overly stocky looks where possible. Use clipped frames with minimal border radius to frame images elegantly.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth with overlapping elements and z-index.
Never center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Use provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text for images.
